dedupe_keys.name: shared socioeconomic pathways ssp scenario explorer and database

description: The SSP Scenario Explorer is the reference source for the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways, five storylines of future society, economy and demography to 2100 that underpin climate impact and infrastructure demand scenarios. It provides the basic elements, with updated GDP and population projections by country released in 2025, and the integrated assessment model quantifications of energy, land use and emissions developed for CMIP6 and released in 2018, with a map explorer, a legacy 2018 web database and links to the SSP-Extensions and ScenarioMIP explorers. It is hosted by IIASA with the contributing modelling teams. The data are available free in the web explorer, with Python and R API access, under an IIASA licence adapted from CC BY 4.0 that aims to keep reused data up to date. Caveats: the site offers a login, whether bulk downloads need an account was not checked, and national projections need downscaling for local infrastructure studies. It supports long-term demand, exposure and adaptation scenarios for multi-sector infrastructure planning; a related record is the Climate Impact Explorer.
